title: Contact High
edition: First edition, September 2013; out of print

description.main: Richard Kern's 2013 PictureBox book of young women smoking marijuana, photographed between 1999 and 2013 and edited by Jesse Pearson. The first of Kern's "High" books; a tall 96-page softcover, now out of print.
description.extended:
Richard Kern's book of young women smoking marijuana, nude or half-dressed, photographed between 1999 and 2013, published by PictureBox in 2013 and the first in what became a run of "High" books.

The series began in 1999, when Kern met a model in Los Angeles who reminded him of the girls he had smoked with as a teenager in North Carolina. He photographed her at her house and in the swamps around Charleston, South Carolina, and kept photographing the subject for the next fourteen years. Jesse Pearson, editor of Apology magazine and previously of Vice, edited the book for PictureBox's photography line. It is a tall 14 by 11 inch sewn softcover of 96 pages with about 90 colour photographs, the title set in script lettering on the cover and spine. It launched on 5 September 2013 at Feature Inc. in New York, where Kern's show Medicated, etc. ran until 12 October, and is out of print.

Kern, born in Roanoke Rapids, North Carolina, in 1954, made the Cinema of Transgression films of the mid 1980s, Fingered and The Right Side of My Brain among them, before turning to photography. Taschen published New York Girls in 1997, Action in 2007 and Shot by Kern in 2013. Contact High was followed by Extra High (Innen, 2020) and Super High (Friends Editions, 2024); the library also holds Extra High, Medicated and Half Half.
description.artist_bio: Richard Kern (born 1954, Roanoke Rapids, North Carolina) is a New York photographer and filmmaker. His 1980s films (The Right Side of My Brain, Fingered, Submit to Me) belong to the Cinema of Transgression; since the 1990s he has photographed young women for Taschen (New York Girls, Action, Shot by Kern), Vice, Purple and others, and self-publishes zines and small books through Innen, Friends Editions and his own site.
description.exhibition_context: Launched at the opening of Richard Kern, Medicated, etc., Feature Inc., 131 Allen Street, New York, 4 September to 12 October 2013.

notes: Shelf: Araki / Kern. Spine read by the owner as Contact Sheets; identified as Contact High, whose cover and spine title is set in script lettering, and not yet checked against the copy. Edited by Jesse Pearson. First edition, out of print; PictureBox's site is gone, so the publisher link is the Artbook/D.A.P. page. Trim 11 x 14 in per PictureBox and the artist. About 90 colour photographs.
